svg.title: Kepler-64: Real-world physics rebuilt for a 2D chessboard
svg.desc: Four pairings showing how Kepler-64 translates real physics onto a chessboard: Mass to piece weight, Gravity to pull along legal moves stopping at blockers, Light speed to a 2-move limit, and Field to square ownership.

g.text: Whoever pulls harder owns the square.
